Hi Olivia —

Thanks for the quote and the consolidation idea — nice to see a cleaner SKU. A few technical items we need clarified before we can move to commercial:

1) Telemetry retention: What are the default and extended retention windows for EDR telemetry and vuln scan history? We have data residency + retention requirements for EU customers that may require a longer window or exportable archives.

2) KV / API access for the MDM device inventory: Does the consolidated license include API access for bulk export? We rely on that for our asset sync.

3) Resource impact of continuous scanning: If we schedule weekly full scans + ad-hoc probes, how does that affect agent CPU budget and how is that reflected in licensing (concurrent vs per-endpoint counts)?

If you can send a short answer to each point (or an updated doc), we can share internally and confirm term preference. For commercial questions I'll let Marissa drive price/term tradeoffs.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad

Subject: Re: FleetSecure renewal quote and consolidation option (MDM / EDR / Vuln)

Hi Mina / Marissa —

Thanks for the quick review. Short answers below and attached an updated commercial memo:

1) Telemetry retention: Default EDR telemetry retention is 90 days. We offer extended retention packs at 1 year or 3 years (S3-based archival) for an additional fee — documented in section 3 of the updated memo. For EU region customers we can enable regional storage to meet residency requirements.

2) API access: Consolidated license includes full REST API access for device inventory and export. We will flag the endpoints for bulk exports in the API docs (no extra SKU).

3) Scan impact: Full weekly scans run with a low-priority agent mode; median CPU impact is ~3-6% on typical developer machines. Concurrent scanning does not change licensing; licensing is per enrolled endpoint.

Commercial asks: we updated pricing for 24 months with the 6% term discount and included a 20% buyout credit for legacy VulnScan licenses (see attached). True-up is annual by default but we can move to quarterly with an administrative fee.

Attachments: FleetSecure_Renewal_Quote_v2.pdf (updated pricing)

Let me know if you'd like a short (30m) call to walk through.

Thanks,
Tyler Singh
Solutions Engineer | FleetSecure Inc.

I reviewed the v2 commercial memo. We will supply a short redline set and a standard security addendum (SOC 2 + data processing addendum) back to FleetSecure. Preliminary notes:
